description: Run a SQL statement against a Supabase project's database via the Management API. Destructive statements require confirm: true.

access_token.description: Optional Supabase access token. Omit to use the connected login.

confirm.description: Set true to allow a destructive statement the guard would block.

project_ref.description: Supabase project ref (the xxxx in xxxx.supabase.co).

name: supabase_execute_sql
